candidates.proposed_claim: When the heart line forks with one branch resting on Jupiter and the other between the first and second fingers, it signifies a happy, tranquil nature, good fortune, and happiness in affection.
candidates.source_quote:
When the line of heart forks, with one branch resting on Jupiter, the
other between the first and second fingers, it is a sign of a happy, tranquil
nature, good fortune, and happiness in affection
candidates.mapping_note: Two-branch fork: this candidate can only encode ONE branch's location (Starting_Point=rising_from_Mount_of_Jupiter) because Starting_Point is a single-valued attribute in ontology_registry.json -- there is no clean second slot for the other branch's location ("between the first and second fingers", which would be Starting_Point=between_Jupiter_and_Saturn per HL_003's existing token). No new attribute was invented per the HARD RULE; flagging for Sulabh to decide whether a second antecedent, a compound value, or a new attribute is warranted. Note also: the existing verified sibling rule HL_013 (same source sentence, negative branch -- "fork so wide one branch Jupiter, other Saturn = uncertain disposition") encoded its distinguishing signal via Width=wide rather than Starting_Point; Sulabh may want this candidate's encoding to stay consistent with that choice instead of (or in addition to) the Starting_Point antecedent used here.
